0022600114.text: The Knicks, 0-2 and on a two-game losing streak, host the 0-2 Orlando Magic in New York's third game of the 2026-27 season, sitting 4th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and 11th in the East. New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), who has averaged 5.0 points in 13.7 minutes per game this season, while Orlando, also on a two-game skid and 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Knicks' most recent meeting was a 132-120 win in Orlando on December 13, 2025.
